title: Computational & formal testbed for GCT obstructions (Perm vs Det, Grenet, Kronecker/plethysm)
summary: Verified dc(perm_2)=2, Grenet's 7x7 M_3(X) symbolically in Z[X] and on 50 random integer 3x3 matrices (dc(perm_3)<=7), and Grenet's 15x15 M_4(X); proved Pieri padding interlacing and verified 100% small-degree symmetric Kronecker occurrence positivity mirroring BIP (JAMS 2019); blocked by BIP No-Occurrence-Obstructions, #P-hardness of Kronecker/plethysm multiplicity obstructions, and Algebraic Natural Proofs.
